summary: Robo.ai Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) for September 22, 2026. The EGM will consider routine governance resolutions: increasing authorized share capital from US$400,000 (200M shares, split 25M Class A/175M Class B) to US$4,000,000 (2B shares, 250M A/1.75B B), adopting amended articles, and authorizing directors to implement the change. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special situation is present. The vote mechanics reflect Class A (25 votes/share) vs. Class B (1 vote/share). This is a routine capital-structure and governance matter, not a special-situation event.
